-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Butoh Magic.png  |title= Butoh Magic |kanji= 舞踏魔法 |romaji= Butō Mahō |english= Dance Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Kiato }} {{Nihongo|Butoh Magic|舞踏魔法|Butō Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to cast spells through dancing.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to cast spells through dancing. The user is able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, whi
    As the user dances, they enter a trance-like state and their attacks become unpredictable.{{Clr}}
